DT Parser historical checksum archive (pre-4.20.0)
Each block preserves the original checksum file verbatim.

### GOLDEN_CORE_SHA256.txt
OBSOLETE AFTER v4.8.2

v4.8.3 intentionally changes a small part of the former Golden Core worker/parser layer.
Use RELIABLE_CORE_SHA256.txt for the current release hashes and change list.
The v4.4.0 baseline remains the historical reference, not a byte-for-byte claim for v4.8.3.

Intentional parser-layer changes in v4.8.3:
- resilient profile also applied to the main Bot/local fallback;
- category/browser 403/429 fast-fail retry budget;
- release-scoped Redis runtime + fresh-jobs-first;
- dynamic page identity with final /seite:N authority;
- Page cache wait 450ms;
- View sharding for normal 40+ URL batches.

stable_engine.py, filtering semantics, final date verification and exact-view extraction remain unchanged.
